description: This file defines the EntityFieldRenderer class used in Drupal's Views module to render entity fields within views, handling multiple relationships, entity types, and translations.

classes.name: EntityFieldRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering entity fields within Drupal views, managing relationships, translations, and display configurations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with view, relationship, language, entity type, entity type manager, and repository.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts related to entity translation rendering.

methods.name: getEntityTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the entity type being rendered.

methods.name: getEntityTypeManager
methods.description: Provides access to the entity type manager.

methods.name: getEntityRepository
methods.description: Provides access to the entity repository.

methods.name: getLanguageManager
methods.description: Provides access to the language manager.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a query with optional relationship parameter.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders entity field data for a given result row and optional field.

methods.name: buildFields
methods.description: Builds render arrays for all fields of all result rows, handling entity translation and display configuration.

methods.name: getRenderableFieldIds
methods.description: Returns a list of field IDs that should be rendered, filtered by relationship.
